description: Header file defining ASN.1 structures for 3GPP RRC NR UL-CCCH messages, including message types and sequence structures.

classes.name: ul_ccch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of message type in UL-CCCH message, including methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ul_ccch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the UL-CCCH message sequence containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type for ul_ccch_msg_type_c.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit buffer.

methods.name: c1
methods.description: Returns reference to the c1 choice structure.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1.
